question: Build the approved-brief publication handoff (spec section 3 Writer, section 6, phase 4): a frozen brief and its write ticket become a reports/<report-id>/ package of publication sources (Markdown with stable section and claim references, small data, figure definitions, build manifest with hashes), a deterministic HTML build (PDF where the existing renderer allows) into an output directory outside git, a rebuild check, and a revision proposal when a later result lands; nothing is drafted before the authorising turn.
done_when: tools/publish.py and tests exist; a scratch brief from tools/conversationalist.py produces a package and an edition; a clean rebuild reproduces the HTML byte for byte; a missing input is named precisely; system/methods/publication.md and one section in system/agents/report-writer.md describe the handoff.
